info.title: Website Screenshot API - Full-Page Captures, Scrolling Video & PDF Output
info.description: Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording. Supports multiple output formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, MP4, GIF, and WebM. Returns a screenshot URL, timestamps, format metadata, and all echoed parameters. Returns a 400 error for an invalid or missing url, and a 408 error if the capture exceeds the configured timeout.

get.summary: Build screenshots the way real users see the web — not just what fits on the screen.
get.description:
Capture full-page screenshots and videos of websites with advanced options like device simulation, custom code injection, cookie banner blocking, and scrollable content recording.
Supports multiple output formats including JSON, image, GIF, MP4, and WebM.

parameters.name: block_specific_requests
parameters.description: Comma- or newline-separated list of specific requests to block. Each line and comma are treated as separate requests for processing. Example: https://example.com, https://example.js

parameters.name: blur_selector
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of indexed CSS selectors to blur. Format: index:<selector>, e.g., 0:.banner,1:#ads.

parameters.name: remove_selector
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of indexed CSS selectors to remove. Format: index:<selector>, e.g., 0:.banner,1:#ads.

parameters.name: result_file_name
parameters.description: Specify a meaningful and unique file name to easily identify the screenshot result. Avoid using spaces or special characters; use hyphens or underscores to separate words.

parameters.name: scrolling_screenshot
parameters.description: **`Scrolling Screenshot`**: Capture a long scrolling screenshot. When true, disable `fullPage` and `freshScreenshot`.

parameters.name: scroll_speed
parameters.description: Speed of scrolling during the screenshot.

parameters.name: scroll_back
parameters.description: If true, the scroll will reverse back to the top after reaching the bottom.

parameters.name: start_immediately
parameters.description: If true, the scrolling capture will start immediately upon page load.

parameters.name: multiple_scrolling
parameters.description: If true, multiple scrolling screenshots will be taken at different viewport sizes.

parameters.name: sizes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of viewport sizes in format index:XXw:YYh. Example: sizes=0:120w:300h,1:240w:500h

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds for the scrolling capture. Acceptable range is 0 to 60 seconds.

parameters.name: fail_on_error
parameters.description: If true, returns an error when the target page responds with 4xx or 5xx status.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Specify longitude for the browser Geolocation API.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Specify latitude for the browser Geolocation API.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Allows defining a proxy for the connection. Provide a JSON string with keys: server (include port number), username, and password.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Custom HTTP headers to include as key=value pairs. Use a semicolon to separate multiple headers (e.g., key1=value1;key2=value2).

parameters.name: cookies
parameters.description: Cookies to include in the request before rendering. Supports single or multiple cookies. Example: cookie=value; otherCookie=otherValue;

parameters.name: scroll_to_element
parameters.description: Scrolls the page to bring the specified CSS selector into view before capture.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element. Only that element is rendered.

parameters.name: selector_to_click
parameters.description: CSS selector for an element to click before capturing the screenshot.

parameters.name: click_recursion
parameters.description: Number of times to click the selector (when set via selector_to_click). Default: 1.

parameters.name: user_agent
parameters.description: Custom User-Agent string sent in the request headers.

parameters.name: accept_languages
parameters.description: Sets the accepted languages for the HTTP request. Sent as the Accept-Language header.

parameters.name: scroll_delay
parameters.description: Delay in milliseconds between scroll steps when lazy_load is enabled.

parameters.name: custom_html
parameters.description: Custom HTML to render instead of loading a URL. Overrides the url option.

parameters.name: image_quality
parameters.description: Compression level for JPEG output (0–100). Lower = smaller file, higher = better quality. Only applies to JPEG.

parameters.name: extract_markdown
parameters.description: Extracts rendered page content as a structured .md (Markdown) file.

parameters.name: get_image_urls
parameters.description: Extracts all image URLs from the rendered DOM and returns them in structured format.

310.description: Too Many Redirects. The target URL redirected too many times for a final page to be reached.

value.message: The target URL redirected too many times (redirect loop), so a final page could not be reached.

400.description: Bad Request. Missing, invalid, or malformed request parameters, SSL certificate problems on the target site, unsupported output or extraction options, or a request that was aborted before completion.

value.message: Your URL is incorrect
please pass correct parameters
The url parameter is required but was not provided.
The file_type value is not a supported output format.
The proxy value is malformed or invalid.

invalidGeolocationParameter.summary: Latitude or longitude out of range

value.message: The latitude or longitude value is outside the allowed range.

invalidCssUrl.summary: css_url is not a valid URL

value.message: The css_url value is not a valid URL.

invalidJsUrl.summary: js_url is not a valid URL

value.message: The js_url value is not a valid URL.
The JavaScript passed in js is invalid and could not be executed.
The clip[x], clip[y], clip[width] or clip[height] values are invalid.

invalidInputSyntax.summary: Non-integer value for an integer parameter

value.message: A parameter that expects an integer received an invalid value.

errSslProtocolError.summary: SSL certificate problem on the target site

value.message: A secure connection could not be established because of an SSL certificate problem on the target site.

errSslUnrecognizedNameAlert.summary: SSL certificate does not match the domain

value.message: The SSL certificate does not match the domain. The site may be down or may have moved.
HTML, Markdown or text extraction is not supported.

invalidScrollingFileType.summary: Unsupported file type for scrolling capture

value.message: PNG, JPG and WEBP are not supported for scrolling capture. Use a video format such as MP4, WEBM or GIF.
The request was aborted before it completed, for example due to a timeout or cancellation.

407.description: Proxy Authentication Required. A tunnel connection to the target could not be established.

networkConnectionFailed.summary: Tunnel connection could not be established

value.message: A tunnel connection to the target could not be established. Check the URL and proxy setting.
A tunnel to the target failed. Verify the URL and proxy settings.

408.description: Request Timeout — Screenshot capture exceeded the configured timeout

value.message: The request took too long to complete. Please try again later.

444.description: Connection Closed Without Response. The target site closed the connection unexpectedly or returned no data.

value.message: The target site unexpectedly closed the connection.
The target server closed the connection without returning any data.

495.description: SSL Certificate Error. The browser and the target website have incompatible SSL/TLS versions or ciphers.

value.message: The browser and the target website have incompatible SSL/TLS versions or ciphers.

503.description: Service Unavailable. The request could not be completed due to temporary unavailability on the target or capture service.

value.message: The request could not be completed due to temporary unavailability, such as a closed browser. Retry the request.

errSocketNotConnected.summary: Target page may be down or moved

value.message: The target page may be temporarily down or may have moved permanently.

ScreenshotResponse.description: Website screenshot response containing the screenshot URL and metadata.

screenshot.description: URL of the captured screenshot image file.

url.description: The original URL that was captured.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the screenshot was created (ISO 8601 format).

ttl.description: Time until the screenshot expires (ISO 8601 format).

file_type.description: The file type of the output (e.g., PNG, JPEG).

width.description: Viewport width used for capture in pixels.

height.description: Viewport height used for capture in pixels.

fresh.description: Whether a fresh render was performed.

full_page.description: Whether full page capture was used.

destroy_screenshot.description: Whether the screenshot was destroyed after generation.

fail_on_error.description: Whether the request failed on error.

block_fetch.description: Whether Fetch API requests were blocked.

get_image_urls.description: Whether image URL extraction was enabled.

longitude.description: The longitude value used for geolocation.

latitude.description: The latitude value used for geolocation.

proxy.description: The proxy configuration used for the request.

headers.description: The custom headers that were included in the request.

cookies.description: The cookies that were included in the request.

scroll_to_element.description: The element that was scrolled to before rendering.

selector.description: The element that was selected for rendering.

selector_to_click.description: The CSS selector that was clicked before capture.

click_recursion.description: The number of times the selector was clicked.

blur_selector.description: The elements that were blurred in the output.

remove_selector.description: The elements that were removed from the output.

css.description: The custom CSS that was injected into the page.

css_url.description: The external CSS URL that was loaded.

js.description: The custom JavaScript that was injected.

js_url.description: The external JavaScript URL that was loaded.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string that was used.

accept_languages.description: The Accept-Language header that was used.

delay.description: The delay duration that was applied in milliseconds.

thumbnail_width.description: The thumbnail width that was used in pixels.

output.description: The output type that was used.

image_quality.description: The image quality level that was applied.

timeout.description: The actual timeout duration that was applied in milliseconds.

adjust_top.description: The vertical position that was scrolled to in pixels.

wait_for_event.description: The event that triggered the rendering to start.

grayscale.description: The grayscale level that was applied (0-100).

scrolling_screenshot.description: Whether scrolling screenshot mode was enabled.

multiple_scrolling.description: Whether multiple scrolling captures were performed.

sizes.description: The dimensions used for each capture.

duration.description: Duration of scrolling capture in seconds.

result_file_name.description: The final filename used for the output file.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
